pack.title: Unit 10.0 Assess Endpoint Security Capabilities
pack.notes: Needs revision: written hands-off; Mr. Flauto has not checked it yet. WIP: written without class materials; needs a pass once they are made.

questions.stem: During a test before a ski resort's new lift-ticket server goes live, a penetration tester gets in through a remote access service and a database port that the resort never uses. Which of the following would BEST stop an attacker from doing the same?

choices.text: Monitor the server's files for changes
Add intrusion detection to the server

reference.title: Endpoint Hardening
reference.find: Hardening describes changing an operating system

questions.stem: A newspaper's subscription server is fully patched, and its host-based firewall allows only web traffic, yet attackers keep breaking in through the subscription web application it runs. Which of the following would BEST stop these attacks?

choices.text: Harden the web application's own settings
Move the web application to its own network segment
Turn on full disk encryption for the server
Remove unneeded programs from the server

reference.title: Endpoint Hardening
reference.find: application to make it operate securely

questions.stem: An attacker got into a hotel's reservation system through the wireless card of a front desk PC that normally uses only its wired connection. Which of the following hardening steps would BEST prevent this kind of attack?

choices.text: Apply a strict control policy to USB ports
Turn on automatic screen locks on the PC
Encrypt the data stored on the PC's drive
Disable network interfaces the PC does not need

reference.title: Endpoint Hardening
reference.find: explicitly disabled rather than simply left

questions.stem: To keep malware on a rental counter PC from easily reaching its billing servers, a car rental company moves each group of systems onto its own subnet with its own security controls. Which of the following mitigation techniques BEST describes this change?

reference.title: Endpoint Protection
reference.find: systems are divided into separate segments

questions.stem: Employees at an architecture firm keep downloading free drawing tools that turn out to hide Trojans and spyware. Which of the following would BEST detect and block these programs on the firm's workstations?

reference.title: Endpoint Protection
reference.find: now perform generalized malware detection

questions.stem: A credit union requires that everything on each teller workstation's internal drive, including the operating system's own files, be unreadable without the correct key. Which of the following BEST meets this requirement?

reference.title: Endpoint Protection
reference.find: the entire contents of the drive

questions.stem: Skilled attackers got past a charity's antivirus software and stayed hidden on its laptops for months. Which of the following should the security team add to BEST protect the laptops against advanced persistent threats like this?

reference.title: Advanced Endpoint Protection
reference.find: responds to advanced persistent threats

questions.stem: A shipping company wants software on each dispatch server that checks that server's own logs and traffic against known attack signatures and then alerts staff or blocks the attack. Which of the following BEST fits this need?

reference.title: Advanced Endpoint Protection
reference.find: monitor and protect individual hosts

questions.stem: An attacker replaced a system program on a ferry company's booking server with a look-alike that records passwords, and no one noticed for weeks. Which of the following would BEST alert the IT team to this kind of change in the future?

reference.title: Advanced Endpoint Protection
reference.find: used to detect changes on endpoints

questions.stem: A mortgage lender's security team wants an alert when an employee account that always connects to the network from the main office during the workday suddenly connects from overseas at night. Which of the following would BEST provide this alert?

reference.title: Advanced Endpoint Protection
reference.find: analyzing the behavior of users within

questions.stem: A construction firm's payroll clerk only enters timesheet data, so IT gives the clerk's account edit rights to the timesheet folder and no access to the rest of the file server. Which of the following BEST describes this decision?

reference.title: Endpoint Configuration
reference.find: only be granted the minimum permissions

questions.stem: On a symphony orchestra's file server, the fundraising group must be able to edit the donor spreadsheets, managers may only read them, and all other staff must be denied. Which of the following should the administrator configure?

reference.title: Endpoint Configuration
reference.find: a list of rules or entries

questions.stem: A call center wants its agents' PCs to start only the phone, ticketing, and chat programs that IT has approved and to stop every other program from running. Which of the following should the security team configure?

reference.title: Endpoint Configuration
reference.find: denies execution unless the process is

questions.stem: Every night, a moving company's management server checks each office PC's password rules and disk encryption setting against the company's security standard and reports any PC that does not match. Which of the following mitigation techniques BEST describes this process?

reference.title: Endpoint Configuration
reference.find: adhere to mandatory security configurations

questions.stem: When a clerk signs in to a ticket counter PC at a movie theater chain, a management tool finds that the PC's firewall has been turned off and automatically turns it back on to match the required settings. Which of the following mitigation techniques BEST describes this process?

reference.title: Endpoint Configuration
reference.find: used to apply and maintain standardized

questions.stem: Staff at a tax preparation office keep switching off the screen lock and firewall settings that the office's baseline requires on its Windows PCs. Which of the following would BEST keep these settings in place on every PC?

choices.text: Track setting changes with file integrity monitoring
Enforce the settings through Group Policy
Add endpoint detection and response to each PC

reference.title: Endpoint Configuration
reference.find: Group Policies enforce security settings

questions.stem: Visitors at a science museum could plug their own flash drives or keyboards into the touch-screen exhibits in its halls. Which of the following would BEST reduce this risk?

choices.text: Turn on each exhibit's host-based firewall
Disable each exhibit's unneeded physical ports
Remove unneeded programs from each exhibit

reference.title: Hardening Techniques
reference.find: unnecessary physical ports such as USB

questions.stem: A film studio must stop video editors from copying unreleased footage to their own USB drives, while the studio's approved USB backup drives keep working on the same PCs. Which of the following BEST meets these requirements?

choices.text: Disable the USB ports on the PCs
Encrypt removable media used on the PCs
Turn on user behavior analytics for the editors
Install port control software on the PCs

reference.title: Hardening Techniques
reference.find: might block all USB mass storage

questions.stem: The PCs in a school's testing lab are used only for online exams, yet a security assessment finds that each one has a large attack surface. Which of the following hardening steps would BEST reduce it?

choices.text: Change the default passwords on the PCs
Turn on automatic updates for the PCs
Uninstall software the PCs do not need
Encrypt the hard drives in the PCs

reference.title: Hardening Techniques
reference.find: reducing the number of software applications

questions.stem: Before a marketing agency gives its old laptops to a recycling company, IT securely erases each drive and resets each laptop to factory settings. Which of the following mitigation techniques BEST describes this process?

reference.title: Hardening Techniques
reference.find: resetting devices to their factory settings

questions.stem: To cut equipment costs, a real estate office will stop buying tablets for its agents, who will run the office's listing app on tablets they own. Which of the following deployment models is the office moving to?

reference.title: Mobile Hardening Techniques
reference.find: device is owned by the employee

questions.stem: A regional airline will buy one tablet model for all of its pilots and keep ownership of every tablet, but pilots may also use the tablets for their own email and web browsing. Which of the following deployment models BEST fits this plan?

reference.title: Mobile Hardening Techniques
reference.find: the device is chosen and supplied

questions.stem: A food truck company gives smartphones to its drivers and wants to install its ordering app on every phone and stop drivers from adding any other apps. Which of the following would BEST let the IT team do both?

choices.text: Apply the settings through Group Policy
Create a geofence around the company's kitchen
Enroll the phones in an MDM platform
Move the phones to a CYOD deployment model

reference.title: Mobile Hardening Techniques
reference.find: MDM helps centralize and enforce
